 Open Navigation Menu Menu Search Search News Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross Are Back at It (Scoring David Fincher Movies)
 The duo’s work on The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth will be their sixth collaboration By Alex Suskind November 2, 2026 Trent and Atticus after winning an Oscar for The Social Network (Getty Images) Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Like David Fincher was going to get someone else to score The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth . Pitchfork can confirm the filmmaker has reunited with longtime collaborators Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross for his forthcoming Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood spinoff. It hits theaters November 25, with a Netflix premiere set for December 23. The film stars Brad Pitt, reprising his role as Booth, alongside Elizabeth Debicki, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, and Scott Caan.
 The Nine Inch Nails duo have scored Fincher’s last six movies, dating back to 2010’s The Social Network , which netted them Oscars for Best Original Score. You can revisit some of their film work in our rundown of The 50 Best Movie Scores of All Time .
